description: Early 2025-11..2026-04 observed-liquidation+funding panel on 4h cadence. Supersedes TRACKA-HL-EARLY-20261111T191958Z which was INADMISSIBLE due to 1h candleSnapshot returning empty historical rows. 4h candleSnapshot returns complete historical candles. This is a NEW design/cadence, not a reopening of sealed 1h outcomes.

candles.license: Hyperliquid public API, unauthenticated; no terms restriction on research use identified

labels.label_construction: notional_usd-weighted event count per symbol per 24h UTC bucket (sum of notional_usd per symbol per day)

panel_construction.unit: symbol x 24h UTC bucket (aligned to 00:00 UTC)
panel_construction.target: next-24h observed liquidation intensity (liq_notional_usd shifted -1 day)

features: rv_4h: trailing 4h realized volatility from 4h log returns (1 period)
rv_24h: trailing 24h realized volatility from 4h log returns (6 periods)
rv_168h: trailing 168h realized volatility from 4h log returns (42 periods)
baseline_features_B1.model_form: OLS on log(target + 1e-12) with standardized predictors (training-only mean/std)

candidate_features_C2.description: B1 features plus pre-specified funding-conditioned features
features_B1_plus: fundingRate: latest funding rate at or before forecast origin (signed)
abs_funding_90d_pct: percentile rank of |fundingRate| vs prior 90 calendar days (min 30 obs)
funding_premium: mark/index premium at forecast origin (when available)
funding_ema_dist: mark/EMA24 distance at forecast origin
candidate_features_C2.model_form: Same OLS form as B1, additional predictors appended

splits.note: Test blocks are 30-day non-overlapping with 7-day embargo between blocks. Block 2 extends beyond 2026-04-30 window; data after 2026-04-30 will be excluded. Effective test blocks within window: blocks 0 and 1 (2 blocks). If <3 blocks feasible, record as PILOT/INCONCLUSIVE with exact shortfall.

metrics.primary: QLIKE on next-24h liquidation intensity (lower better)

inference.method: block bootstrap resampling complete 30-day UTC time blocks jointly across instruments

pass_criteria.relative_qlique_reduction_ge_2pct: C2 relative QLIKE reduction vs B1 >= 2%
pass_criteria.min_5_paired_instruments: >= 5 symbols with paired forecasts in test blocks

inadmissibility_criteria: Insufficient candles for RV computation (rv_24h requires 6 4h bars, rv_168h requires 42)
Insufficient label coverage (< 5 symbols with labels in test blocks)
Insufficient test blocks (< 3 non-overlapping 30-day blocks within window)
